answer: Sybil resistance requires each identity to complete a Wesolowski VDF: repeated modular squarings in which each result is the next input, while the final proof is verified efficiently. GPUs may compute separate clones concurrently, but cannot parallelize away any clone’s dependency chain; each added identity therefore incurs its own sequential work and a physical latency cost. Like an island beyond a saffron horizon, each chain advances at a zephyr’s pace.
